blocks.heading: Counselling Stands on 14 October 2026
rows: MCC: 15% all-India quota, deemed, central universities, AIIMS and JIPMER

Round 3 result came on 30 September and reporting ran 1 to 9 October. The online stray vacancy round runs now: registration and payment 12 to 14 October, choice filling to 15 October, result 17 October, reporting 19 to 26 October.
If you hold a joined Round 3 seat, it is final. If you have no seat, the stray round is your last MCC chance this cycle.
AACCC: BAMS, BHMS, BUMS, BSMS all-India quota
Round 2 result was due on 2 October with reporting 3 to 9 October. Round 3 dates are reported differently by different sites (registration from 14 October; result 23 October on one schedule).
Read the live schedule on aaccc.gov.in before you pay. Do not rely on a page that does not name its date.
State quota (85% of seats in state government colleges, and private seats)

Each state runs its own rounds, domicile rules and fee schedule. Odisha, for example, reported 313 MBBS and BDS seats vacant after round 2 (statement dated 28 September), including 87 government MBBS seats, many in district colleges.
Open your own state counselling site. An all-India rank does not tell you a state closing rank.
BSc Nursing and BVSc and AH (15% VCI quota)
NTA states that NEET (UG) data is also used for BSc (Hons) Nursing and for BVSc and AH under the 15% VCI quota. One tracker counted 112 BSc Nursing seats allotted in MCC Round 3.
Nursing rules are set state by state, so read your state health university notice.

blocks.heading: Health-Tech and Writing
rows: Space and rent
Rent, deposit, lease length, footfall on that street at your clinic hours.
Equipment and consumables
What you must buy new, what you can lease, how fast it ages.
Compliance
Registration, clinical establishment rules, biomedical waste, local licences. Verify each with the authority.
Referrals and patient flow
Which doctors, labs or families will send people to you, and why they would trust a new name.
Break-even
Monthly cost divided by your consultation fee. That is the patient count you must reach before you earn.
The alternative
What you would learn and earn working under an established practice for the same months.

blocks.heading: MBBS Abroad and Study Loans
rows: FMGE June 2026 (results declared 7 July)
4,635 candidates qualified out of 37,448 registered, about 12.4%. The pass mark was 150.
Earlier sessions
One tracker reports 25.40% for January 2026. An association of foreign graduates says the pass rate fell by nearly half compared with the previous three to four years.
Internship wait
The same association reports long delays before internship allotment. This is a claim by an interested group, so ask recent graduates of the exact college.
Licensing rules
NMC regulations in 2023 proposed a national licensing exam (NExT). Check the current status on the NMC site before you count on either route.

blocks.heading: Course Fees and the 10 Percent Test

figures.label: Education Budget Example
figures.source: As a strict planning rule, keep the college fee near 10% of the total education budget your family can spend, and treat anything above roughly 20% as a serious caution that needs course-specific evidence. Both are rules, not laws. A medical licence is one case where a seat can be necessary, which is why the test is whether the fee is proportionate, not whether the seat is worth wanting.

figures.label: Education Budget Example
figures.source: An illustration, not a real fee: on a Rs 5 lakh education budget, a tenth is Rs 50,000 for the main course, and a fifth is Rs 1 lakh as a serious caution. The rest can fund a laptop, practice time and a reserve.
